scope: fixed historical old8 only; no untouched confirmation claim
question: Does restarting the existing adjacent-frame LK/RANSAC helper in short windows centered within a previously sealed temporal-QA interval provide more locally usable candidate tracklets, and can adding same-model frozen ROI appearance association help?

data_authority.reused_temporal_qa: artifacts/stvg_temporal_caption_query_spatial_opd_v1/STUDENT_GLOBAL_BARRIER.json plus the eight sealed student/<case_id>.pt files
data_authority.no_gt_precondition: all source, candidate, and QA barriers/files must verify their existing source bindings and GT_read=false before any plan is written

temporal_centers.interval_source: reused temporal_fit.final_interval from the sealed old-eight QA student output; no new teacher call
temporal_centers.clock: physical frame IDs with half-open [start,end) semantics, as used by methods/decota_final_simplified_v1/objectives.py:25-34
temporal_centers.rule: Form four equal-width interval-bin centers. For each center target, choose the nearest source-grid physical frame ID within the QA interval; break an exact tie toward the smaller frame ID.
temporal_centers.failure_rule: Abort manifest creation if fewer than four source-grid IDs fall in the interval, any target snaps to a duplicate ID, or a selected ID is not in the canonical frame map. Do not silently reduce, move, or replace centers.
temporal_centers.window: For each center, use physical IDs center-2 through center+2, clipped only to the canonical video's physical coverage. Require the matching local-frame indices to be consecutive. Do not clip the window to the QA interval.
temporal_centers.cross_window_policy: Every center is an independent reinitialization. Never link tracklets between windows or interpret a repeated seed ID as evidence that the same physical instance was followed.

candidate_seeds.source: Use exactly the existing displayed_candidate_ids from the sealed P0 candidate barrier, preserving its order.
candidate_seeds.limit: Source plus at most four existing non-Source seeds; cases with fewer candidates remain smaller and are not refilled.
candidate_seeds.source_anchor: At a center, use the frozen Source normalized xyxy prediction at that exact source-grid position.
candidate_seeds.seed_anchor: For each existing non-Source displayed candidate, copy its original normalized anchor_box_xyxy unchanged at every selected center. Do not translate it relative to Source, use its old long-track trajectory to decide eligibility, or create a replacement seed.
candidate_seeds.proposal_semantics: A non-Source anchor is a fixed region proposal hypothesis only; it is not a known object instance or identity. Source uses the actual frozen native prediction at that center.
candidate_seeds.geometry_policy: Do not clip. Preserve an invalid/out-of-bounds seed as an explicit invalid anchor and do not pass it to LK. Preserve every existing displayed candidate ID even if its anchor is invalid.
candidate_seeds.selection_policy: No GT, tracker outcome, QA confidence, or visual inspection may add, remove, or reorder seed IDs.

shortLK.method: Call scripts/stvg_adjacent_affine_tracklet_v1.py::track_adjacent unchanged for each fixed center/seed window, with the shared seed box at the center frame as anchor. shortLK and shortLK_frozenROI must share exact centers, candidate IDs, anchor geometry, and source windows.

existing_helper_config.failure: the existing helper stops that direction after the first rejected transition

shortLK_frozenROI.shared_inputs: Must use the exact same centers, source frame windows, candidate IDs, anchor boxes, and existing LK output as shortLK.
shortLK_frozenROI.feature_source: A new frozen forward capture from the existing TA-STVG model only; no new backbone, tracker network, or pretrained tracker.
required_capture_metadata: physical frame ID to feature slice mapping
resize and padding transform from original pixels to feature-map coordinates
source checkpoint SHA-256 and model-state SHA-256
source query/model mode and no-update status
unlocked_choices: which existing frozen TA-STVG spatial feature stream to pool
whether association is a per-frame descriptor readout or a constrained LK proposal association
the exact score and tie/unknown handling
shortLK_frozenROI.execution: Do not run this component until the feature capture and association contract is separately reviewed and frozen.

manifest_contract.planned_readout: one complete case JSON per fixed old-eight case plus one private resized RGB/grayscale npz per case and GLOBAL_TRACKLET_BARRIER.json; no label or model outputs
per_case_bindings: source case SHA and source model-state SHA
source-grid IDs SHA and reused QA student SHA
QA physical interval and QA-to-source-grid exact match
candidate barrier record SHA and exact fixed displayed candidate IDs/window IDs
canonical REQUEST SHA, source-video SHA, canonical-video SHA and declared canonical pixel SHA
physical frame IDs and canonical local indices for every short window
center seed anchor geometry and per-window unique tracklet IDs
Source uses native prediction at the center; each non-Source proposal copies the original anchor box unchanged at every center
every center/proposal pair has an independent local tracklet ID; repeated IDs across centers do not imply object identity

limitations: All eight cases are historically exposed development sources.
A proposal/window ID is not a ground-truth object identity.
The existing sealed source cache contains no per-frame spatial feature map; the frozen ROI arm requires a new, explicitly bound frozen forward capture.
This proposal is not an executed experiment, GT readout, object-identity claim, or method promotion.
